findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Relocate the single shared readiness definition to a stdlib-only module the venv-free probe can import (e.g. a `scripts/` module), rather than `conftest.wait_for_jira_dc_ready`, so both the pytest harness and the `python scripts/...` probe consume ONE definition and AC4 is actually achievable.
evidence: .github/workflows/jira-dc-epic-link-probe.yml:43-44 'NO LLM key and NO `uv sync` are needed: the probe imports only the standard library'; :69 runs `python scripts/jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py`
tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py imports `rebar_reconciler`, pytest, and `_engine_path` — not importable from the probe's stdlib-only job

scripts/jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py:131-168 `_await_named_fields` is the probe's own copy of this exact wait (bug 9790-cafa-dffa-462e), so 'shared' must resolve to a module the venv-free probe can import
AC4: 'the probe workflow and the harness workflow share one readiness definition, so they cannot drift' — unachievable if the definition lives in the pytest conftest
findings.finding: The Fix places the ONE shared readiness definition inside `conftest.wait_for_jira_dc_ready`, but the probe workflow runs a venv-free, stdlib-only `python scripts/jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py` job that cannot import the pytest conftest — so the probe cannot share that helper, defeating AC4's 'share one readiness definition so they cannot drift'. A standalone stdlib-only `scripts/` module that BOTH tiers import is the structurally-better home.
findings.location: Plan §Fix ('Best placed in the readiness helper both tiers share (`conftest.wait_for_jira_dc_ready`)') and AC4
scenarios: Implementer puts the poll only in `conftest.wait_for_jira_dc_ready`; the probe cannot import it, so its `_await_named_fields` stays a second definition — AC4 fails and the two gates drift, the very outcome the AC exists to prevent.
findings.suggested_fix: State the shared home as a new stdlib-only `scripts/jira_dc_field_readiness.py` (pure predicate + transport-injected poll) that the harness conftest and the probe both call, keeping the workflow curl loop as the cheap first gate.
